import numpy as np
## Compensated joint series 11 (three probes, distinct widths, cutoff 2.2)
low = np.array([[0., 1.], [0., 0.]], dtype=complex)
def emb(op, k):
    out = np.ones((1, 1), dtype=complex)
    for j in range(4):
        out = np.kron(out, op if j == k else np.eye(2))
    return out
s = emb(low, 0)
vs = [emb(low, k) for k in (1, 2, 3)]
A = s.conj().T @ s
h0 = 0.013 * A + sum(d * v.conj().T @ v for d, v in zip((-0.45, -0.64, -0.84), vs))
operators = np.array([h0, np.zeros_like(h0), A, s, *vs])
alpha = 0.027
cutoff = 2.2
dP = -alpha * np.sqrt(np.pi) * cutoff**3 / 4
phonon_series = np.zeros((7, 256, 256), dtype=complex)
phonon_series[0] = -1j * dP * (np.kron(np.eye(16), A) - np.kron(A.T, np.eye(16)))
gamma = 0.012
widths = np.array([0.025, 0.033, 0.029])
assert np.allclose(total_liouvillian(operators.copy(), phonon_series.copy(), gamma, widths.copy(), alpha, cutoff), target)
